title: Browser overlay and resize continuity
scope: Keep Agent identity popovers above neighboring native Browser surfaces and preserve the last valid Browser frame through transient resize geometry.
acceptance: An Agent avatar hover/focus popover can be read without a neighboring Browser WebContentsView covering it.
Every popover close, blur, Escape, unmount, and error path releases the native-surface occlusion lease.
A transient zero-size layout during window or pane resize does not send a null Browser bounds update.
Real visibility changes, parking, errors, screenshot and selection overlays retain their existing hide behavior.
